Keep Furnaces and Cannons at their original level. Merging level 2, 4 or 5 Furnaces, and Cannons beyond level 2 is not recommended.
Iron Cap upgrades raise the amount Iron Crates give, not only maximum iron.
Try to avoid using Iron Crates except where the guide says to use them.
Summon Musks and Knights in pairs, or one of each + 4 banners. This conserves space and supports more cannons.
Put as much HP on the board as possible before sleeping so cannon damage is less likely to be wasted.
Banner piles should be spawned in groups of 4 so Steel/Gunpowder piles take only one space each.
Day 3 is very active because of high cannon damage.
The final couple million points are intended to come from killing Mages with Bombs.
Alchemy Table pricing varies by level and whether the shop table is used; use the forecast to choose.
If you cannot check often enough to always have targets, keep a Mage on the board and do the math before choosing AT2.
